author: twny2
quote: Car handling, sounds and related stuff is really good, open world is good too tho it had much bigger potential they limited a lot of stuff or it is underwhelmingly implemented but on PC with mods will come thankfully, but story wise it is disrespectful towards the franchise and to Rockstar's image, gta 5 did not have the deepest story either but somehow it is more moving then this which is crazy. So story so far is the biggest let down if the game had a different name then it might pass but this is a gta game for ffs.
